observations: Photo 0 shows a closed silver laptop with an HP logo on the lid, placed on an orange surface next to a white box with a phone on it.
Photo 1 shows the keyboard area of the laptop with two stickers: one for Windows 7 and one for Intel Core i7.
Photo 2 shows the laptop open, displaying the screen (off), keyboard, and touchpad. The screen is dark and reflects the surroundings.
All photos have a watermark: 'COMPUNET COMPUTER POSTED ON JIJI'.
The laptop appears to be a business-class model with a silver chassis and black keys.
No visible damage to the exterior in the photos, but the screen is not powered on.

read_from: Photo 2: Overall design matches HP EliteBook 8570p

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows HP logo; Photo 2 shows design consistent with EliteBook 8570p; seller's text matches.
Photo 1 shows Intel Core i7 sticker.
No photo shows the internal drive or BIOS/OS storage info. Cannot confirm capacity from photos.
No photo shows RAM sticks or system info. Cannot confirm RAM size from photos.
No charger is visible in any photo. Seller claims it is included, but no proof.
This is a marketing claim with no verifiable data in photos or text.

risks.risk: Laptop may not power on or have a dead screen
risks.proof: Video or photo of the laptop turning on, showing a working display and BIOS/OS.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with dead screen, which significantly reduces value.

risks.risk: Internal components may not match claims (e.g., 500GB SSD/HDD, 8GB RAM)
risks.proof: Photo or video of BIOS screen showing RAM size and storage capacity, or a screenshot from Windows Disk Management.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown or lower specs, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Charger may be missing or non-functional
risks.proof: Photo of the charger and its connector, and a video of it powering the laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing charger, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Laptop may have hidden physical damage or liquid damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the keyboard, hinges, ports, and underside, especially around the battery and ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Video of the laptop turning on and showing the BIOS or Windows desktop.
Photo or video of the BIOS screen showing RAM and storage details.
Photo of the charger and its connector.
Close-up photos of the laptop's ports, hinges, and underside.
response.reason: The model and core i7 are confirmed, but critical claims like 500GB, 8GB RAM, and charger inclusion are unverified. The screen is off, so functionality is unknown. Hidden risks like dead screen, wrong specs, or missing charger affect pricing. Proof is needed to price accurately.
